title: Cross-team release synchronization and customer cohort enablement for Private deployments (RBAC / Audit Logs / KMS)
creator: Aisha Nair
description: Coordinated launch plan to ship RBAC, customer-facing audit logs, and KMS key integration for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. This ticket aligns release notes, localized comms, legal signoff, enablement cohorts, support runbooks, and telemetry gating across Product, Engineering, Design, Legal, Security, and GTM. Goal is to move from gated beta to staged GA for paying enterprise customers while minimizing support churn and compliance risk.
goals: (1) Publish synchronized release notes and legal/contract addenda by release cut; (2) Deliver customer enablement cohorts and training materials for 10 pilot customers; (3) Ensure RBAC/KMS/audit-logs meet compliance checklist and pass security review; (4) Wire telemetry and SLO dashboards specific to private deploys.
scope: RBAC role audit API, customer-facing audit-log export (S3/Glue-compatible), KMS envelope encryption integration guide, release notes/KB articles, GTM comms and enablement cohort orchestration, support-runbook and escalation matrix.
out_of_scope: SDK-level changes to public hosted API, dedicated capacity billing model changes, on-prem installer packaging improvements beyond configuration docs.
milestones: 2025-03-05: Internal beta enablement and train-the-trainer session
2025-03-12: Publish release notes and localized KB (EN/DE/FR)
2025-03-22: Gradual GA open to tiered customers
comms_plan: Single source of truth: Confluence release page (private-launch-2025) will be canonical. Communications cadence: 1) Internal all-hands for SRE/Support/AMs on 2025-03-05; 2) Targeted AM enablement bundle and NDA-ready demo decks sent 48h before customer enablement windows; 3) Public release notes + KB published at GA cutoff; 4) Legal contract addendum notified to customer success for enterprise renewals.
